assets.subject: dressed blue-gray stone ashlar masonry
assets.detail: Squared, dressed blocks of blue-gray stone in level horizontal courses about 12 inches tall (exactly 6 courses top to bottom), blocks 16 to 28 inches long, joints staggered like brickwork, thin recessed pale mortar joints, softly rounded block edges, faint warm ochre and moss tints on some blocks.

assets.subject: lime-washed plaster wall infill
assets.detail: Smooth hand-trowelled cream lime plaster with very soft broad tonal variation, faint trowel strokes, a few tiny hairline cracks, a hint of warm ochre wash. No timber, no stones showing, no edges.

assets.subject: rough-sawn horizontal timber planks
assets.detail: Wide rough-sawn honey-brown planks running horizontally left to right, each plank about 9 inches tall (exactly 8 planks top to bottom), straight thin dark gaps between planks, soft wood grain running along the planks, a few iron nail heads, gentle weathering. No vertical boards, no battens, no beams.
